_source: L12 (work plan 2). 5e healing tiers and potion effects, named in Bellmire's plain voice; brewed at the apothecary (!brew <key>), found below on a good search. 'tier' = the town tier the apothecary needs (Roster.town_tier).

mending.name: Draught of Mending
mending.flavour: Red, thin, and it tastes of iron. It works.

greater.name: Greater Mending
greater.flavour: Brewed twice and stoppered with wax.

superior.name: Superior Mending
superior.flavour: The apothecary will not say what is in it.

supreme.name: Supreme Mending
supreme.flavour: A guild price for a guild life.

antidote.name: Bitterleaf Tincture
antidote.flavour: Ends a venom. Ruins a supper.

emberward.name: Emberward
emberward.flavour: Drunk cold. You will want it cold.

hearthwarm.name: Hearthwarm
hearthwarm.flavour: Spiced, and warm all the way down.

quickwater.name: Quickwater
quickwater.flavour: The drinker hears their own heart outrun them.

ogre.name: Ogre's Draught
ogre.flavour: Thick as porridge, and it hits like a door.

shadow.name: Shadowcloak
shadow.flavour: The dark forgets you, until you strike.

bravecup.name: Bravecup
bravecup.flavour: Mead and something stronger than mead.

owl.name: Owl-eye Drops
owl.flavour: Two drops in each eye, and the dark goes grey.

fieldmend.name: Field Dressing
fieldmend.flavour: A rag, a splash of spirits, and no time to be gentle.

stillblood.name: Stillblood Tincture
stillblood.flavour: Thicker than bitterleaf, and it stays down.

clearsight.name: Clearsight Drops
clearsight.flavour: Stings like the truth. Then you can see again.

nightdraught.name: Nightdraught
nightdraught.flavour: The apothecary's own, for the long watch.

wardwater.name: Wardwater
wardwater.flavour: A skinful, blessed at the chapel font.

knitbone.name: Knitbone Brew
knitbone.flavour: Green, and it moves a little in the bottle.

deepdraught.name: Deepdraught
deepdraught.flavour: Brewed for the long descents. Tastes of cold stone and keeps you going.

wyrmsbane.name: Wyrmsbane
wyrmsbane.flavour: Bitter as a dragon's regard. Drink it before the breath, not after.

mirewine.name: Mirewine
mirewine.flavour: Bellmire's own. Braver by the bottle, foolish by the jug.

lastlight.name: Lastlight
lastlight.flavour: Lit against the dark at the bottom of everything.

kingsmend.name: The Hollow King's Cup
kingsmend.flavour: Poured once for a king who would not heal. It heals you instead.

scarwater.name: Scarwater
scarwater.flavour: Drawn from the scar itself. It cuts both ways, and it knows which.

pennymend.name: Pennymend
pennymend.flavour: A copper's worth of mending. Better than nothing, and it knows it.

ratnip.name: Ratcatcher's Nip
ratnip.flavour: He drinks it himself, which is the only recommendation it needs.

thawbottle.name: Thawbottle
thawbottle.flavour: Corked in the cold snap and kept for the next one.

longwatch.name: Longwatch Drops
longwatch.flavour: Two drops and a whole night. The walls are walked on these.

commanders_flask.name: The Commander's Flask
commanders_flask.flavour: E3PO carries one and has never opened it. That is the point of it.

mirestep.name: Mirestep
mirestep.flavour: The mire lets go of your boots. Everything else still has hold of you.

quarryblood.name: Quarryblood
quarryblood.flavour: What the masons drink on the day a wall has to go up.

gravewater.name: Gravewater
gravewater.flavour: Drawn from the chapel well, behind the stones. It holds the first blow.

deepstill.name: Deepstill
deepstill.flavour: Brewed thick for the floors where help is a very long way up.

bellwater.name: Bellwater
bellwater.flavour: Blessed under a bell with no clapper. It rings anyway, and so does this.

sweetwater.name: Sweetwater
sweetwater.flavour: Bellmire's own well, boiled with honey. Mends a little and lifts a lot.

cloisterbrew.name: Cloisterbrew
cloisterbrew.flavour: The chapel brews it for the watch and charges the guild double.

doorkeep.name: Doorkeeper's Draught
doorkeep.flavour: Drunk on the threshold. Keep the door, and the door keeps you.

foxfire.name: Foxfire Drops
foxfire.flavour: Cold green light behind the eyes, and the dark turns shallow.

grainmeasure.name: The Grain Measure
grainmeasure.flavour: Four doses to a flask, and the apothecary counts them out loud.

hushwine.name: Hushwine
hushwine.flavour: Nobody remembers the drinker. The drinker included.

fellstill.name: Fellstill
fellstill.flavour: Two ills in one bottle, and it tastes of both.

lampwater.name: Lampwater
lampwater.flavour: Thin and oily, and the dark goes one lamp wider.

quarrymend.name: Quarrymend
quarrymend.flavour: Grit in the bottom of the flask. Drink that too.

fenward.name: Fenward
fenward.flavour: Boiled out of the worst water in Bellmire. It knows poison personally.

criers_cup.name: The Crier's Cup
criers_cup.flavour: One swallow and the whole room can hear you.

stonewater.name: Stonewater
stonewater.flavour: Settles in the chest like a kept wall.

hostsilence.name: Host's Silence
hostsilence.flavour: The rattle stops. So does everything else about you.

coldcount.name: Coldcount
coldcount.flavour: Mourncoil taught the apothecary this one, unwillingly.

wallmend.name: Wallmend
wallmend.flavour: Masons' brew. It does for a man what mortar does for a course.

tollwater.name: Tollwater
tollwater.flavour: Paid in advance. The road goes past quicker.

clearfen.name: Clearfen Drops
clearfen.flavour: Stings worse than whatever blinded you. Works faster, too.

ferrywater.name: Ferryman's Measure
ferrywater.flavour: Drunk at the crossing. Paid for on the far bank.

brightbone.name: Brightbone
brightbone.flavour: Knits what the Ossuary Lord undid. Tastes of chalk and says so.

emberdregs.name: Ember Dregs
emberdregs.flavour: The bottom of the emberward jar, sold cheap. Still puts you out.

rushlight.name: Rushlight Draught
rushlight.flavour: Cheaper than a lamp, and nothing down there sees you carrying it.

mustering_cup.name: Mustering Cup
mustering_cup.flavour: Poured at the barracks door. Nobody drinks it sitting down.

quietwater.name: Quietwater
quietwater.flavour: Bellmire's oldest answer to a bad decision.

oxdraught.name: Ox-Draught
oxdraught.flavour: Drovers' brew. Doubles the man, and the appetite with him.

mirethistle.name: Mirethistle Tincture
mirethistle.flavour: Bitter as the fen it came out of. Swallow it, do not sip it.

watchmans_pint.name: Watchman's Pint
watchmans_pint.flavour: Slow and steady, like the man they named it after.

millrace.name: Millrace
millrace.flavour: Goes through you the way the river goes under the wheel.

chapelwater.name: Chapel Water
chapelwater.flavour: Blessed on a feast day. Works on the other days as well.

scarbite.name: Scarbite
scarbite.flavour: The scar in a bottle. The apothecary charges extra for the stopper.

poisoned.does: disadvantage on attacks; venom keeps hurting

blinded.does: disadvantage on attacks; foes have advantage

resist_fire.does: half damage from fire; no burning

resist_frost.does: half damage from frost; no slowing

invisible.does: foes cannot pick them; advantage on the first blow, which ends it

warded.does: turns aside the first blow each round

regenerating.does: knits a little hurt back each second

scar_touched.does: its next spell is doubled - or misfires; the scar decides
